svg.title: Harvest-to-dry-room reconstructable handoff
svg.desc: A handoff record organizes authorization and source identity, output identity and destination, quantity and reconciliation status, condition and environment, sanitation or hold state, deviation, escalation, and next action so partial completion and unresolved issues remain visible.

g.text: Dry-room handoff: transfer facts, not just material
Work order • room • plant / batch / lot
Container / lot ID • verified rack / location
Outgoing + receiving value • units • discrepancy state
Partial completion is truthful. Do not convert an open discrepancy, hold, root cause or release status into a guess to make the handoff look complete.
Course 6 supports receiving and handoff evidence. Independent product release/disposition authority is not conferred.
